description: Reads recent Fetch, XHR, and Beacon request hops with supported response metadata and complete text bodies when available.

pageId.description: Target page ID whose network snapshot should be read.

timestamp.description: Optional Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds. Includes requests initiated at exactly this time.

urlPattern.description: Optional RE2 search expression matched against the complete request URL. Maximum length is 4096 characters.

responsePattern.description: Optional RE2 search expression matched against complete available JSON or text response bodies. Metadata-only redirect hops are excluded; binary and Base64 bodies are excluded. Maximum length is 4096 characters.

purpose.description: Describe why you need API response bodies or redirect metadata, e.g., verifying a form submission or extracting dynamic business data

pageId.description: Target page ID that owns the snapshot.

requestId.description: Stable request identifier for this captured request hop.

status.description: HTTP response status, or null when unavailable.

mimeType.description: Response MIME type, or null when unavailable.

requestBody.description: Complete request body when provided by the browser, or null.

responseBody.description: Complete supported JSON or text response body; empty when the browser exposes metadata but not the body.

responseBodyAvailable.description: Whether responseBody contains the complete body. Redirect hops may be false when CDP cannot retrieve their body.

responseBodyBase64Encoded.description: Always false because binary/Base64 response bodies are excluded.

timestamp.description: Unix epoch request initiation time in milliseconds.

durationMs.description: Request duration in milliseconds, or null when unavailable.

items.description: One captured API request hop and its response metadata/body.

apis.description: Captured API request hops matching all supplied filters.

collectionStartedAt.description: Unix epoch milliseconds when the current collection generation started.

oldestAvailableAt.description: Oldest retained request timestamp, or null when no records exist.

evictedCount.description: Records evicted by TTL or bounded FIFO quotas in this generation.

pendingCount.description: Target API requests still awaiting completion or response-body retrieval.

observation.description: Facts directly observed by the Action or returned by its declared result schema.

suggested_prompt.description: Guidance to re-observe current state and choose the next operation.

data.description: Validated business result returned by the Action.

message.description: Concise public explanation for the failure code.

observation.description: Directly observed failure fact; it must not infer an unobserved browser side effect.

details.description: Only fields listed by the public error definition detailFields are returned; private execution diagnostics are omitted.
